entries.title: Calendar save/load oracle re-ran randomized engine startup after loading
entries.first_observed: The second temperate seed in the first complete M21 exact-twin matrix failed the calendar save/load comparison.
entries.impact: A seed-dependent qualification failure could incorrectly classify correct restored engine state as divergent and prevented G21 acceptance.
entries.root_cause: The post-load comparison called StartupEngines again; that mutating initialization path can consume introduction randomness instead of reading the state restored from the save.

entries.title: M22 late-stage sampling and expanding retention accuracy rejected a valid campaign boundary
entries.first_observed: The first complete six-process M22 development campaign was rejected after specialist-router seed 1636894266 stopped producing checkpoints beyond update 16.
entries.impact: Independent weighted draws could underrepresent late programs, and a miss confined to a newly introduced program was mislabeled as catastrophic forgetting, preventing complete evidence retention and weakening broad-policy training coverage.
entries.root_cause: The rollout sampler had no per-program episode floor, while retention compared aggregate accuracy across expanding program denominators instead of checking whether a previously passing program was lost.

diagnostics.review_note: The accepted M14-G21 implementation retains zero nonclosed defects or divergences. V2-DEF-0002 records and closes the M22 sampler and retention-classification failure found by the first complete matched development execution: its source correction, targeted CUDA reproduction, revised-source exact recovery, and complete six-campaign rerun all pass. ChooChoo, SimpleAI, and malformed Lufthansa packages retain their truthful rejection dispositions; ShipAI's M14 healthy-inactive result remains supplemented by M18 scenario-specific active evidence. G20 publishes external-AI choices as stochastic replicates, and G21 deliberately claims only the finite ten-package NewGRF compatibility set.
